Class OrderTemplate

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.order.template.OrderTemplate
@Entity public class OrderTemplate extends Object
A client's saved ticket setup. Prices are stored as percent offsets from the price the side fills at, so the template fits whatever the market is on the day it is applied.
